## Instructions

1. Cream shortening and sugar; beat in egg and molasses.
2. Dissolve soda in the hot water.
3. Sift flour with spices and salt; add alternately with the water.
4. Drop by spoonfuls on a greased sheet.
5. Bake at 375°F for 10 minutes. Do not overbake.

## Notes

Kids take them to school in wax paper.
